149.solution: The diodes point in opposite directions, so whichever way the cell drives current, exactly one of the two \(30\,\Omega\) branches conducts. The circuit is then \(70\,\Omega\) in series with \(30\,\Omega\): \(I = \dfrac{3}{100} = 0.03\) A.

150.solution: \(Y = \overline{A + B} \cdot \overline{A \cdot B}\). Whenever \(\overline{A + B} = 1\), both inputs are 0 and \(\overline{AB} = 1\) too, so \(Y = \overline{A + B}\): a NOR gate.
